# Known failures for the rust_test job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml:
# Rust tests that fail at a sami release for a reason another change fixes.
# The job passes only when exactly the tests named here fail. It fails when a
# test that is not named fails, and when a named test passes or no longer
# exists: remove its line then, so the list empties as the fixes land.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <reason: the change
# that fixes it and its issue>. The name runs to the first two spaces, so a
# doctest's name, such as `src/lib.rs - f (line 3)`, is written whole.
# A reason that starts with `flaky: ` marks a test that fails on some runs:
# Bazel runs its target up to 3 times, and the test is known when it failed
# on some attempts and passed on another, new when it failed on every
# attempt, and a pass (with a notice) when its first attempt passed.
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_integration_tests_tests/feed_reads_test the_shell_reads_the_bytes_an_externals_feed_holds  flaky: a race in the test row 'stdin a deferral's own redirection replaces' (exec 6> fifo with no reader after cat ends); #203's 43efd44a fixes it in Cut10
